reason: Conversation 2 leads with 'unplug first', covers the vent hose/duct check in its opening (the expected sensible first step) alongside filter and programme, keeps both cut-out and element on the table, and once the customer reveals no rear access and no multimeter it escalates cleanly to an engineer who can test continuity, which matches the ground truth. Conversation 1 never asks about the vent hose (the customer had to volunteer it), wrongly mentions a 'condenser' on a vented dryer, repeatedly asserts a failed element is 'very likely' despite the clogged-hose history pointing more toward a cut-out, suggests the cut-out 'may just need resetting', and largely repeats itself across its last two turns. Both correctly withhold a part number, but Conversation 2's main flaw is only a premature 'Failed heater element' heading that its body text hedges, whereas Conversation 1 is less efficient and less honest about the diagnosis.
